hooks.name: Spec Consistency Check
hooks.description: Keeps story files, tasks.md and work-item-map.yaml in agreement whenever a spec file changes.

action.prompt:
A spec file under .kiro/specs/ changed. Check the feature folder it belongs to for internal consistency:

1. Every story listed in work-item-map.yaml has a file on disk at the path given, and every story file on disk appears in the map.
2. Every story ref in tasks.md resolves to a story file.
3. Every ref in a story's dependsOn front-matter resolves to a real story.
4. A story marked state: Done has all implementation tasks checked, and vice versa.
5. Effort totals in work-item-map.yaml capacity match the sum of story effort values.

Report only mismatches, each as one line naming the file and the fix. If everything agrees, say 'Specs consistent' and stop.
